all_historical_figures.name: Brahma, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara
all_historical_figures.significance: Mentioned as the seers of the Prāṇa-pratiṣṭhā-mantra in the context of Rṣyādi-nyāsa, establishing the divine origin of the mantra.

all_historical_figures.name: Indra
all_historical_figures.significance: The status of Indra ('śukra-tattvam') is mentioned as the benefit of offering a seat (āsana) to the deity.

all_historical_figures.name: Talakādu Kṛṣṇa-Dīkṣita
all_historical_figures.significance: Edited the 'Arcanāprakāśa' (published 1962), the primary source compilation for the procedure described in this chapter.

all_historical_figures.name: Śiva
all_historical_figures.significance: The central deity to whom the Nityārcanā is offered.

all_historical_figures.name: Gaṇeśa
all_historical_figures.significance: Worshipped at the beginning of rituals to remove obstacles.

all_historical_figures.name: Durgā
all_historical_figures.significance: Worshipped at the main door along with Gaṇeśa.

all_historical_figures.name: Kṣetrapāla
all_historical_figures.significance: Guardian of the temple grounds, whose permission is sought before worship.

all_historical_figures.name: Caṇḍikeśvara
all_historical_figures.significance: An important devotee of Śiva who receives the 'nirmālya' (remains of worship).

all_historical_figures.name: Naṭarāja
all_historical_figures.significance: The iconic representation of Śiva worshipped during pradośa-pūjā.

all_historical_figures.name: Gayaprāta
all_historical_figures.significance: Mentioned as the ṛṣi of the Vedic hymn 'Apai...' used for manuṣya-gandha nirharaṇa (warding off the effect of human breath).

all_historical_figures.name: Kaṇḍu
all_historical_figures.significance: Mentioned as the ṛṣi of the Brahma-pāra-stotra, a hymn recited to gain eligibility for worship.

all_historical_figures.name: Merupṛṣṭha
all_historical_figures.significance: Mentioned as the ṛṣi of the mantra for sanctifying the seat (āsana).

all_historical_figures.name: Alasiṅga-bhaṭṭa
all_historical_figures.significance: Author of the commentary on the Sāttvata-Saṃhitā text excerpted in the chapter.

all_historical_figures.name: Maheśvarānanda-nātha
all_historical_figures.significance: Compiled the Paramānanda-Tantra, from which these excerpts are taken.

all_historical_figures.name: Āchārya-Raghunātha-miśra
all_historical_figures.significance: Edited the edition of the Paramānanda-Tantra published by Sampūrṇānanda Sanskrit University.
